decision.design_goal: Restore the historical Beacon HUD feeling as one always-readable instrument panel, updated only where necessary to expose restored ADV_Elite organs.
panel_content_priority: GNSS/Sky Anchor state without external raw-coordinate exposure

ticker.visual_role: Restore the memorable moving-text strip from the earlier Beacon UI.
ticker.truth_guard: Ticker text must preserve truth classes; predictions/simulations/persona text cannot be displayed as observed fact.
ticker.implementation_note: Recover exact historical ticker mechanics/text placement from older Beacon donors during P1 where possible; otherwise reproduce the behavior faithfully without game UI.

visual_language.base: historical Beacon HUD colors and compact instrument styling
visual_language.retro_cosmic: subtle sci-fi/terminal ambience, not game cockpit

performance_guard: avoid full-screen redraws when partial updates suffice
stale/missing values must be shown explicitly rather than filled with fake data
